points.description: States pressure (pressure force / pressure gradient) as a force in the Navier-Stokes equation.
States gravitational force (gravity / body force due to gravity).
States viscous force (viscosity / viscous stresses / friction due to viscosity).

rubric.notes: One point per listed force; the three marks are shared about equally, and the total is rounded to the nearest whole mark (0, 1 or 2) as the teacher does. Clear synonyms are accepted (e.g. body force from gravity, friction from viscosity). Wrong or unrelated forces earn nothing, and do not cancel correct ones.
